home.title: Welcome to Blue Zone Twente
home.description:
Blue Zone Twente aims to promote healthy aging in caring neighborhoods. This aligns with the Overijssel province's Positive Health program. Blue Zone Twente harnesses the power of Twente's citizen initiatives so that together we can grow stronger and build a healthy future. Become part of this movement and contribute to a more vibrant Twente.

Together, we make Twente stronger!
home.coreValuesSubtitle: Blue Zone Twente is based on principles that strengthen healthy living, connection, and well-being. We combine exercise, a healthy lifestyle, healthy eating and drinking, and connection into a lifestyle that supports people.
home.communityConnectionDesc: Strengthening social relationships, caring for each other, and creating neighborhoods where everyone feels welcome.
home.healthyLivingDesc: Choosing conscious and primarily plant-based food, with a focus on moderation and sensible drinking.
home.sustainabilityDesc: Encouraging natural, daily movement that fits into everyday life.
home.lifelongLearningDesc: Creating space for meaning and moments of peace, so that people remain mentally and emotionally balanced.
home.communityPulseDesc: Quick questions to discover what's important for our region. Share your voice and see what others think.
home.upcomingEventsSubtitle: The place where citizen initiatives, professionals, and network partners come together to share knowledge, connect initiatives, and strengthen each other. With interactive working methods, appreciation for what already exists, and a positive, practical approach, we work together throughout the year to create a more vibrant Twente.
home.ctaDescription: With a free account, you can easily stay informed, read more about what's happening, and contribute your ideas whenever you want. This way, you can contribute in your own way to a more vital and stronger Twente.

story.title: Building a Healthier, More Connected Twente
story.subtitle: Blue Zone Twente connects people and combines strengths to work on caring neighborhoods where people live longer, healthier, more connected, and more vital lives.
story.originText1: The Twentse Noabers launched Blue Zone Twente on November 1, 2024, with the goal of aging healthily in caring neighborhoods. This aligns with the Positive Health program of the Province of Overijssel.
story.originText2: Living in a community that resembles a Blue Zone has a positive effect on health. Positive Health is about taking good care of yourself and enjoying life. This includes good nutrition, outdoor exercise, a good social life, and participating in society.
story.originText3: The Twentse Noabers are working to strengthen community strength. We model the lifestyle of the five Blue Zones around the world. Together, we make Twente stronger.

blueZones.title: Blue Zones Worldwide
blueZones.subtitle: Learning from existing Blue Zones
blueZones.worldwideText:
The term Blue Zones comes from Dan Buettner (2012), a journalist for National Geographic. He identified these places on Earth, marked them with a blue marker on the world map, and was surprised by the health and life expectancy of the people there.

The six Blue Zones in the world are: Sardinia (Italy), Okinawa (Japan), Loma Linda (California), Nicoya (Costa Rica), Ikaria (Greece), and Singapore.
blueZones.characteristicsText:
Move naturally
Live in an environment that encourages you to move without thinking about it.

Know your goal
Know what you want to wake up for in the morning.

Minimize stress
Consciously take time to relax every day.

The 80% rule
Reduce your calorie intake by 20% (stop eating when you're 80% full, reduce your portion sizes, or practice intermittent fasting daily).

Plant-based foods
Lots of beans (including soy and lentils) and meat a maximum of 5 times a month, fish regularly, mainly minimally processed and high-fiber foods, whole-wheat bread, a handful of nuts, and little sugar.

Drinks
Primarily water, also coffee and tea.

Like-minded people or a religious community
Belong to a group with the same norms and values, with which you meet regularly.

Family
Put family and loved ones first.

Friends
Ensure sufficient social contacts that demonstrate healthy behavior.

story.missionText: Blue Zone Twente strengthens Twente's community by making healthy, meaningful, and connected living accessible to everyone. Through citizen initiatives and inspired by the global Blue Zones, we encourage healthy behavior, social connection, and a living environment where people support each other. In this way, we build neighborhoods and communities where people can grow old healthily and happily.
story.visionText: A Twente where healthy and meaningful living is within everyone's reach. By embracing the principles of Blue Zones and Positive Health, we create a region where people feel supported, can participate, and stay vital longer.

communityFirst.title: Positive health
communityFirst.text: We look at what gives people strength: resilience, joy, and vitality in daily life.

inclusivity.title: Learning and sharing
inclusivity.text: We develop by exchanging experiences, knowledge, and stories. This way, we strengthen each other and, together, make Twente stronger.

transparency.title: Appreciation
transparency.text: We build on what already exists. By recognizing existing initiatives and qualities, space is created for new steps and growth.

sustainability.title: Connection
sustainability.text: We believe in the power of togetherness. By connecting people, initiatives, and ideas, we create an environment in which everyone can contribute and participate.

whatWeDo.title: What We Do
whatWeDo.subtitle: We connect people and initiatives in Twente to create an environment in which healthy and meaningful living becomes possible for everyone.

connect.title: Connect
connect.text: Blue Zone Twente collaborates with residents, initiatives, and organizations to gradually revitalize Twente. We engage with people and discover together which characteristics of Blue Zones are already visible in the region.

learn.title: Blue Zone Characteristics
learn.text:
We learn from the five Blue Zones around the world and from each other. This creates a network that shows how Twente can be a place where people feel supported, can participate, and can grow old healthily.
.

act.title: Learning and sharing
act.text: We value and strengthen what already exists, so that initiatives can grow and new ideas can flourish. By collecting stories, sharing knowledge, and building connections, we continue to build.

people.title: The People Behind Blue Zone Twente
people.subtitle: Meet two local changemakers helping the movement grow.

memberOne.name: Birgit Muijsenberg
memberOne.text:
As project leader of Blue Zone Twente, Birgit Muijsenberg brings a unique combination of strategic insight, the power to connect, and a deep-rooted passion for a more vital society. With a background in social projects and regional collaboration, she understands like no other how to connect partners around a shared mission.

Driven by her interest in lifestyle, health, and the power of communities, Birgit is committed to transforming Twente step by step into a region where people live longer, healthier, and happier lives. She strongly believes in the power of small, achievable changes that together have a major impact. Her motivation stems from the conviction that everyone, regardless of background or age, deserves access to an environment that makes healthy behavior a given.

With her open mind, enthusiasm, and sharp eye, Birgit inspires and connects people. She builds bridges between science, practice, and the daily lives of Twente residents, working tirelessly towards a future where well-being is paramount.
